editorial:
Imagine waking up to a city covered in a weird fog where people with superpowers are suddenly turning up dead. That is the crazy situation you get into here. You follow the Armed Detective Agency, a group of quirky heroes who usually fight the Port Mafia. But when a mysterious guy called the Collector starts stealing everyone's abilities, these two rival groups have to stop fighting and actually work together. The vibe is a wild mix of supernatural mystery and funny character moments, making it feel like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse throughout the streets of Yokohama.

What really hits home is the stunning animation and the fast-paced fight scenes. The twists keep you guessing, though the plot can feel a bit confusing if you are not paying close attention. If you love seeing rivals team up against a bigger threat, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that the Collector is actually a manifestation of Atsushi's own inner fears and self-doubt. He was not a real person, but a mirror of the pain Atsushi felt. Once Atsushi accepts himself and finds the strength to move forward, the Collector vanishes. The fog clears, the stolen abilities return to their owners, and the city is saved. The rivals go back to their usual bickering, but they have a new respect for each other.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superpowers and team-up stories.
